text.arabic_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍۢ سَوَآءًۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that resumes and coordinates the prior creator discourse
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah by attaching it to the creator claim in 41:9 before any new object appears. The reader hears the stabilizing, blessing, and measuring acts as elaboration of the same lordship argument, not as a detached cosmological notice; even the prefixed surface makes the first verb enter through linkage.

topics.headline: opening continuation of 41:9
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 41:10 begins as continuation and evidence for the creator claim in 41:9, not as a fresh detached scene.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction coordinates the new perfect verb with the prior discourse and keeps agency continuous across the boundary.

words.gloss_range: configured making, placing, and assigning stabilizers within the earth-domain
words.root_gloss_range: j-ʿ-l spans making, placing, appointing, and rendering; the local Form I perfect selects completed functional installation
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) starts the three-verb chain as completed functional installation. It takes the stabilizer noun as its object and carries the silent creator subject forward from 41:9, so the mountains are not just observed terrain but stabilizers deliberately set into role. The same root also reverses the audience's rival-making in 41:9: false human assignment is answered by effective divine assignment, then linked onward to blessing and calibrated provision.

topics.headline: making as functional installation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb installs the stabilizers into a role rather than merely reporting that they exist.
topics.reason: The verb is Form I perfect, governs the stabilizer object, and carries the making/placing/appointing range into a local installation sense.

topics.headline: silent subject and perfect aspect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency is compressed, not absent: the same creator remains the actor through the perfect verb chain.
topics.reason: The third masculine perfect has no local subject word, but the prior creator reference supplies the agent while the perfect presents the act as completed.

topics.headline: first verb in ordered creation chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from stability to blessing to measured allocation instead of listing unrelated acts.
topics.reason: The repeated coordinated perfects place this verb first, and the supplied pair evidence links the making root with stabilizer and measuring language.

topics.headline: same-root reversal from 41:9
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the making root crosses the ayah boundary from illicit rival-making in 41:9 to legitimate divine installation in 41:10.
topics.reason: The same root recurs across the boundary with a changed agent and object, creating a local contrast between false assignment and effective creation.

words.gloss_range: first earth-domain locative phrase, before the stabilizer object
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) anchors the making inside the earth before the stabilizers are named. Its feminine suffix reaches back to the earth in 41:9, and the preposition works as both location and domain: the stabilizers are received as earth-internal from the start. This first occurrence also begins the ayah's repeated locative refrain.

topics.headline: earth-domain precedes the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth-domain before the stabilizer object, so the placement is heard as internal to the same earth already named in 41:9.
topics.reason: The pronoun resolves to the prior earth and the prepositional phrase attaches to the first verb before the object appears.

topics.headline: first recurrence of the earth refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is the first beat of a repeated earth-reference that will bind all three divine acts to one domain.
topics.reason: The same phrase recurs later with blessing and measuring, making the first occurrence the start of a local refrain.

words.gloss_range: plural firm-set stabilizers, grammatically the object of making and spatially qualified from above
words.root_gloss_range: r-s-w centers settling, anchoring, and mooring; the local noun selects firm-set stabilizers rather than a generic landscape label
words.prose: {{ar:رَوَٰسِىَ}} ({{tr:rawāsiya}}) is the first concrete object of the ayah: plural firm-set stabilizers made by the opening making verb. Its r-s-w field makes the mountains function as anchors, with the plural distributing stability across the earth. The following upper-side phrase gives them an upper-side orientation, while parallels such as 16:15 and 21:31 keep the swaying-prevention logic audible without needing it stated here.

topics.headline: stabilizers receive the making act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the stabilizers are the produced object and then receive a spatial upper-side qualification.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative direct object of the first verb, indefinite plural in class force, and can be qualified by the following upper-side phrase.

topics.headline: mountains named by stabilizing function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names the mountains by anchoring and firm-set function rather than by scenery alone.
topics.reason: The root field of settling and mooring and the active-participle-like plural shape support a functional stabilizer reading.

topics.headline: known stabilizer formula opens the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recurring Quranic stabilizer formula, including 16:15 and 21:31, placed before blessing and provision.
topics.reason: The supplied references connect the same stabilizer noun with making and swaying-prevention formulas, and local order makes stability the first platform.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the upper-side phrase and mediating source, side, or surface relation
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) governs the upper-side phrase rather than adding a loose adverb. Its range lets the stabilizers be read from, from the side of, or upon the earth's upper face; because the phrase follows the object, the reader first receives anchors and then relocates them spatially. The nasal onset also makes the particle a small audible hinge into the bound direction phrase.

topics.headline: preposition mediates the upper-side relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the spatial relation is mediated by a preposition, so the anchors are re-read through source, side, and surface orientation.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following directional noun and can scope either the placement act or the stabilizer object.

topics.headline: small acoustic hinge into direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the particle as a brief audible hinge binding into the following direction phrase.
topics.reason: The row makes a minor sound observation that is preserved only as supporting texture.

words.gloss_range: earth-relative upper side, governed by min and narrowed away from rank superiority
words.root_gloss_range: f-w-q spans above-ness, height, superiority, and excess; the local construct with the earth suffix selects concrete upper-side relation
words.prose: {{ar:فَوْقِهَا}} ({{tr:fawqihā}}) makes upperness earth-relative. Governed by the preceding preposition, the construct and suffix measure direction from the earth itself, so the broader f-w-q field of rank or superiority is narrowed into visible surface placement. Because the qualifier lands after the stabilizer object, the reader first recognizes the anchors and then feels their upper-side placement; intertexts where above-ness marks superior agency, such as 48:10, work here as contrast.

topics.headline: upperness measured from the earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that above-ness is not abstract vertical hierarchy but a relation possessed by the earth-reference itself.
topics.reason: The directional noun is governed by the preceding preposition and bound in construct to the same feminine earth suffix.

topics.headline: rank-above field restrained to surface placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the wider above/superiority field only as contrast, while the local syntax keeps the meaning on earth-surface placement.
topics.reason: The root can carry superiority, and 48:10 illustrates that field, but the local construct with the earth suffix and governing preposition selects concrete topological above-ness.

topics.headline: delayed qualifier gives spatial weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a delayed spatial qualifier that makes the anchor phrase tactile after the object has already been recognized.
topics.reason: The direction phrase lands after the stabilizer object and carries both structural and sound weight.

words.gloss_range: second coordinating conjunction, adding blessing under the same creator subject
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the blessing verb makes blessing a second complete predicate under the same silent creator subject. It adds a new act while moving the sequence forward from stability toward productive increase, and the repeated conjunction begins to sound like a patterned action chain.

topics.headline: second wāw coordinates blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that blessing is a distinct coordinated act and also the next step after stabilizing placement.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the blessing verb to the first perfect without creating a new subject, while the repeated particle sustains the chain.

words.gloss_range: conferred productive blessing embedded in the earth-domain without a direct object
words.root_gloss_range: b-r-k joins blessing, increase, settledness, and abiding benefit; local Form III selects conferred earth-internal productivity
words.prose: {{ar:بَٰرَكَ}} ({{tr:bāraka}}) sits at the center of the verbal sequence. It has no direct object here; the following earth-domain phrase supplies the domain, so blessing is embedded through the earth rather than pointed at one named item. The b-r-k field makes this more than generic favor: after firm-set stabilizers, it is productive increase that remains, and blessed-land language such as 21:71 is specialized here into earth-internal endowment before measured provisions follow.

topics.headline: blessing diffused through the earth-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that blessing is not aimed at one object but diffused through the earth as a domain.
topics.reason: The verb lacks an explicit direct object and takes the locative/domain complement instead.

topics.headline: barakah as abiding increase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices blessing as earth-internal productivity that abides after the stabilizers have been set.
topics.reason: The root field joins abiding and increase, and the Form III verb presents conferred increase toward a domain.

topics.headline: middle verb turns stability toward measured supply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the middle beat converting stable earth into productive earth before provision is calibrated.
topics.reason: The verb stands between the stabilizer object and the measured provision object in the three-act architecture.

topics.headline: blessed-domain formula specialized here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that blessed-land language, including 21:71, is specialized here as blessing inside the earth-domain.
topics.reason: The supplied references connect blessing with marked domains, while the local repeated locative internalizes the blessing.

words.gloss_range: second earth-domain locative phrase, supplying the domain for objectless blessing
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) gives the objectless blessing verb its domain. The suffix repeats the same earth antecedent, and the recurrence turns the earlier location into a refrain: placement, blessing, and later measuring all return to one earth rather than scattering across separate scenes.

topics.headline: domain complement of blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that blessing is spatially and operationally embedded in the same earth-domain.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase attaches to the blessing verb and the suffix keeps the prior earth as referent.

topics.headline: location becomes a repeated argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second occurrence turning location into a structural refrain that prepares the third.
topics.reason: The repeated surface phrase gives the second coordinated clause its own domain and anticipates the later recurrence.

words.gloss_range: third coordinating conjunction, adding measuring as the culminated coordinate act
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the measuring verb starts the measuring beat as a separate coordinated act, not a subordinate explanation of blessing. The conjunction preserves the same agency and completes the repeated connective pattern: placement, blessing, then calibrated allocation.

topics.headline: third wāw completes the action chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices measurement as a distinct coordinate culmination after stability and blessing.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction links the third perfect to the prior acts and sustains the repeated chain without collapsing the verbs into one another.

words.gloss_range: Form II measured apportionment of the earth provisions
words.root_gloss_range: q-d-r spans measure, capacity, proportion, value, power, and decree; local Form II selects deliberate calibrated allocation
words.prose: {{ar:قَدَّرَ}} ({{tr:qaddara}}) closes the verbal chain by turning productive blessing into apportioned provision. It is transitive to the earth's provision noun, while the four-day phrase gives the temporal frame, so provisions, not days, are the measured object. The q-d-r field lets power appear as proportion: capability is shown through calibrated sustaining order, and the same root points forward to 41:12 and 41:39.

topics.headline: provisions are the measured object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision itself is apportioned; the time phrase frames the act but is not its object.
topics.reason: The Form II perfect governs the provision noun as explicit object and intensifies measure into calibration.

topics.headline: capacity expressed through measured supply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine power as exact proportioning rather than undifferentiated abundance.
topics.reason: The q-d-r field includes measure, capacity, and power, and the local object narrows the sense to calibrated resource allocation.

topics.headline: same-surah q-d-r arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the measuring verb sets up later same-surah measure and capability language in 41:12 and 41:39.
topics.reason: The supplied local recurrence evidence links this verb to the later nominal measure and divine capability forms.

topics.headline: abundance becomes accountable quantity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence closing when fertile potential becomes accountable, apportioned supply.
topics.reason: The third coordinated clause follows making and blessing and gives concrete content to lordship as measured sustenance.

words.gloss_range: third earth-domain locative phrase, locating apportionment before the provision object
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَآ}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) returns for the third time just as measurement begins. It locates apportionment inside the same earth-domain before the provision object appears, and the repeated pronoun completes the locative architecture: stabilization, blessing, and provisioning all converge on one feminine referent from 41:9.

topics.headline: third domain complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that measured allocation is installed inside the same earth-domain, not treated as abstract decree outside it.
topics.reason: The phrase attaches to the measuring verb and the suffix again resolves to the prior earth.

topics.headline: third fīhā completes the refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the threefold locative refrain binding the whole operative core to one earth.
topics.reason: The third recurrence closes the repeated frame and the written madd adds recitational expansion at that point.

words.gloss_range: earth-bound plural life-support provisions, the direct object of measured apportionment
words.root_gloss_range: q-w-t centers food, sustenance, maintaining life, and sustaining agency; the local plural selects differentiated earth resources
words.prose: {{ar:أَقْوَٰتَهَا}} ({{tr:aqwātahā}}) is the object that the measuring verb measures. The plural makes provision distributive, while the suffix binds those supplies to the earth and its inhabitants. Because q-w-t is rare and concrete, the cosmic sequence concentrates into life-support resources; the echo with the sustaining title in 4:85 sharpens provision as maintained by capable agency rather than as vague abundance. The object is named before the duration, so the time frame serves the provision claim instead of overtaking it.

topics.headline: provisions as earth-bound object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the measured thing is plural provision bound to the earth, not an abstract blessing or free-floating resource.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the measuring verb and carries the same feminine earth suffix.

topics.headline: rare life-support noun concentrates the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah narrowing cosmic creation into concrete life-maintaining supplies through a rare provision word.
topics.reason: The q-w-t field is rare and concrete, and the plural noun carries the life-support sense after the measuring verb.

topics.headline: provision root echoes 4:85 sustaining agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that measured earth resources echo the sustaining-agency title in 4:85 without importing a separate story.
topics.reason: The supplied cross-reference links the same root to sustaining agency, while the local noun keeps the sense material and ecological.

topics.headline: resource object precedes the temporal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the resource object before the duration, making time serve the provisioning claim.
topics.reason: The provision noun appears before the four-day phrase and belongs to the ordered field of stabilizing, blessing, measuring, provision, and time.

words.gloss_range: bare preposition shifting containment from earth-location to temporal span
words.prose: {{ar:فِىٓ}} ({{tr:fī}}) pivots the repeated containment pattern from place to time. After three earth-domain phrases, the bare preposition drops the earth suffix and governs the four-day span, so the reader moves from where the acts occur to the duration in which provision is calibrated.

topics.headline: containment shifts from earth to time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same containment logic turning from earth-domain to measured duration.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the number phrase after three earlier locative forms with a pronoun.

topics.headline: bare fī answers the fīhā refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the fourth prepositional beat echoing the earlier locatives while signaling a new temporal frame.
topics.reason: The bare form echoes the repeated preposition but drops the suffix, and the madd gives the pivot recitational extension.

words.gloss_range: cardinal four governing the counted days under the temporal preposition
words.root_gloss_range: r-b-ʿ covers fourness, fourths, and fourfold arrangement; the local cardinal selects a bounded count, not fractional division
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْبَعَةِ}} ({{tr:arbaʿati}}) fixes the count before the reader reaches the time-unit. It is genitive under the temporal preposition and governs the days noun, so the quantity is bounded even while the semantic range of day or period remains with the following noun. Cross-surah uses of four, including 9:36, show ordered count force; here that force is specialized to provision-time rather than calendar sanctity.

topics.headline: four fixes quantity before duration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the number constrains the measure as a bounded count while leaving the kind of day to the following noun.
topics.reason: The cardinal numeral sits under the temporal preposition and governs the counted plural noun.

topics.headline: four as ordered temporal structure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fourness functioning as structured creation-provision timing, with 9:36 as a contrasting calendar use.
topics.reason: The root field and supplied references support ordered count force, while the local phrase applies it to provision-time.

topics.headline: count precedes temporal interpretation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices bounded measure before any debate over the temporal unit begins.
topics.reason: The numeral comes before the day noun and foregrounds measure first.

words.gloss_range: plural counted days or bounded periods completing the four-day temporal phrase
words.root_gloss_range: y-w-m spans day, event-time, appointed time, and bounded period; the local plural permits process-time while retaining counted units
words.prose: {{ar:أَيَّامٍۢ}} ({{tr:ayyāmin}}) supplies the unit that the four counts. As an indefinite plural genitive, it leaves the type of day open enough for creation-process time while still giving multiple bounded units. Because the time phrase follows the provision object, duration qualifies the provisioning act and anticipates the next same-surah temporal accounting in 41:12. Wider yawm examples such as 32:5 and 70:4 show that this range does not strain the Arabic temporal term, while creation-in-days language is specialized here to earth-provision calibration.

topics.headline: plural days complete the number phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the time span as multiple counted units, not an undifferentiated duration.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive counted plural after the cardinal number and inside the temporal prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: yawm range allows bounded process-time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can bear process-phases while remaining a counted Arabic time term.
topics.reason: The root can denote day, occasion, or bounded period, and examples such as 32:5 and 70:4 stretch yawm beyond ordinary human duration; local grammar still fixes the count.

topics.headline: duration follows the resource object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that time serves the already named provision object and anticipates the next same-surah temporal accounting in 41:12.
topics.reason: The temporal phrase arrives after the provision object and links forward to the continuing creation-time sequence.

topics.headline: days join a broader creation-time formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as part of a broader bounded-creation-time pattern, specialized here to earth-provision calibration.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence links y-w-m with q-d-r and creation-in-days formulas, including same-surah continuation.

words.gloss_range: equality, balance, and completeness qualifying the four-day measure before the audience phrase
words.root_gloss_range: s-w-y spans leveling, equality, proportioning, fashioning, settling, and non-equivalence; the local abstract noun selects balanced completion
words.prose: {{ar:سَوَآءًۭ}} ({{tr:sawāʾan}}) turns the counted span into an evaluated measure. In the canonical accusative it can work adverbially or as a circumstantial qualifier, while accepted case variants expose how strongly the word can attach backward to the days or forward toward the askers. Its payoff is not abstract sameness alone: the measure is balanced and complete before the final asker phrase names the audience, and the same root's nearby recurrence in 41:11 keeps settling and proportion in view. The long-vowel expansion into hamza makes the balance word stand out acoustically at the pivot.

topics.headline: case variants expose the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this word as a syntactic hinge where accepted case variants route equality backward to the days or forward toward the askers.
topics.reason: The canonical accusative licenses adverbial or circumstantial qualification, while variant cases tune attachment without erasing the equality field.

topics.headline: equality joined to adequacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices balanced completion: the span is proportioned in itself and adequate for those who ask.
topics.reason: The s-w-y field joins equality, levelness, proportion, and completeness, which the closing phrase needs together.

topics.headline: equality before the askers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the counted duration becoming an audience-facing answer before the audience is named.
topics.reason: The word stands between the day phrase and the lām audience phrase, making balance precede recipient relevance.

topics.headline: balanced-measure echoes and local s-w-y thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices equality language such as 3:64 specialized here into balanced measure, while 41:11 keeps the same root active locally.
topics.reason: The supplied references include the balanced-word use in 3:64 and same-surah recurrence in 41:11 and 41:34.

topics.headline: sound marks the equality word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the long-vowel and hamza contour making the equality qualifier stand out before the final audience phrase.
topics.reason: The written and recited shape gives the balancing word audible prominence in the closing cadence.

words.gloss_range: prefixed lām directing equality toward the asker class as benefit, specification, or answer
words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the closing noun into a directed audience phrase. The completed equality is for, toward, or with respect to the askers, so the ayah does not end on abstract balance but on benefit and intelligible answer. Its fusion with the following definite participle makes that audience relation tightly attached in recitation.

topics.headline: lām governs the asker class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the measure becoming directed toward a class as benefit, specification, and answer.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition governs the active-participle audience and attaches to the equality qualifier.

topics.headline: preposition and article bind acoustically
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surface fusion that audibly ties the measured equality to its audience.
topics.reason: The prefixed lām compresses with the following definite participial form in the recitational unit.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle naming the class of askers and requesters at the ayah close
words.root_gloss_range: s-ʾ-l spans asking, requesting, petitioning, seeking information, and accountability; the local participle selects an enduring asker/requester class
words.prose: {{ar:لسَّآئِلِينَ}} ({{tr:l-sāʾilīn}}) lands the ayah on a class defined by asking. The active participle and plural make the audience enduring rather than a one-time speaker, while the omitted object lets asking include both inquiry about the measured order and need for the provisions. The close therefore converts the creation sequence into an answer-ready provision account; 51:19 sharpens the requester side by linking the asker with provision-right. The hamza inside the final word and its long ending make the audience closure acoustically marked and sustained.

topics.headline: definite plural active participle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sustained identifiable class of askers, not a single finite act of asking.
topics.reason: The word is a definite masculine plural active participle governed by the preceding lām.

topics.headline: omitted object keeps question and request open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the omitted object lets the final class face both backward to provisions and outward to inquiry.
topics.reason: The asking root spans inquiry and request, and the participle closes the ayah without naming a single object of asking.

topics.headline: cosmic sequence becomes answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final movement from cosmic configuration to the audience who asks about or needs the measured provision.
topics.reason: The final word generalizes the preceding provision sequence as answer-ready for askers.

topics.headline: asker linked to provision right in 51:19
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 51:19 giving the requester relation a provision-right resonance that 41:10 grounds in measured earth resources.
topics.reason: The supplied cross-reference connects the same active-participle field with provision entitlement, while the local close remains a broad asker class.

topics.headline: hamza and long ending mark the final audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final audience word as acoustically sustained rather than clipped.
topics.reason: The rows point to hamza and long ending effects in the closing word.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعل فيها رواسي من فوقها وبارك فيها وقدر فيها أقواتها
baseline_models.mechanism: Placement configures the earth with fixed anchors; blessing establishes productive increase, and deliberate measure converts that capacity into life-maintaining provision.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing assume a condition supplies the configuring act that installs the stabilizing system.
Firm fixation supplies the physical anchoring on which the provisioning system depends.
Spatial elevation locates the anchors visibly upon the earth rather than as an unlocated abstraction.
Stable, growing good supplies the productive capacity held in the earth.
Planning by measure and judgment turns raw fertility into an ordered allocation.
Food that sustains life identifies the allocation's bodily function.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists separate acts involving mountains, blessing, and food.
changed_reading.after: The acts form one causal architecture: stabilization supports durable fertility, which is then deliberately apportioned as sustenance.

baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded amount of life-support is brought to a just or even adequacy in relation to requests; equality need not mean identical portions.

activation_trace.role: A quantity brought to its limit supplies bounded calibration rather than accidental abundance.
Sustenance that keeps life going supplies the criterion by which adequacy is judged.
A just, medial, even position supplies equitable calibration among demands.
Asking and requesting supplies the demand side to which measured provision answers.

changed_reading.before: سَوَاءً suggests the same quantity handed to every asker.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can describe provision calibrated to a fair sustaining adequacy for those whose needs or questions call for an answer.

baseline_models.mechanism: Number, duration, exactness, and asking combine so that the temporal clause itself can function as a complete answer to an inquiry about the work's total duration.

activation_trace.role: Exact quantity and limit supply the numerical precision of the answer.
The number four supplies the explicit total.
A duration of time supplies the unit in which the total is stated.
Equality and equivalence supply the sense of a total that comes out exactly.
The asker supplies an epistemic audience seeking the stated total.

changed_reading.before: The four days are only a chronological datum inside the creation report.
changed_reading.after: The clause is also metadiscursive: it gives an exact, resolved total for anyone asking how the sequence is counted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated جعل contrasts constructive world-ordering with the human assignment of rival counterparts, so the focus's material arrangement also argues for undivided ordering authority.

activation_trace.role: Configuring a thing into a condition anchors the focus's constructive act.
The same configuring image is used for assigning rivals, creating the contrast between rightful and counterfeit arrangement.
Creation as measuring and proportioning identifies prior ordering as the Creator's work.
A contrary counterpart supplies the rival arrangement that the earth's coherent order contests.
Cultivation and completion supply the governing agency behind the focus's stabilization and provision.

structural_cues: 41:9 and 41:10 place two uses of جعل on opposite sides of the earth's creation: humans assign rivals, while the Creator assigns stabilizers and sustenance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated جعل, measured creation, rival counterparts, and lordly cultivation; I infer that coherent provision exposes sole ordering authority. A live alternative is that 41:9 merely frames disbelief without narrowing the lexical force of 41:10.

changed_reading.before: The placement of mountains is a religiously neutral physical act.
changed_reading.after: The act is polemical evidence: the one who configures a stable, provisioned earth is unlike those who configure rival claimants to authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's measured provisions join a larger command system in which domains are directed, comply, receive their own functions, are completed, and are guarded.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate planning anchors provision as an assigned function rather than an accidental yield.
Turning purposefully toward a domain supplies directed transition from earth to heaven.
Willing compliance supplies the responsive execution of the cosmic command.
Perfecting and carrying an act through supplies completion of the ordered structure.
An obligating assignment supplies each heaven with a domain-specific commission.
The returning image of planned measure closes the sequence and links heavenly functions to earthly provision.
Guarding supplies a preservation function alongside nourishment and adornment.

structural_cues: The focus is followed by earth and heaven being addressed together, each heaven receiving its أمر, and the sequence closing with تقدير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction, compliance, assigned commands, completion, guarding, and repeated تقدير; I infer a coordinated functional system. A live alternative treats these as consecutive acts without a shared systems relation.

changed_reading.before: Measured sustenance is a stock placed on an otherwise passive earth.
changed_reading.after: Provision is the earth's commissioned function within a responsive cosmos whose domains receive, execute, and preserve distinct assignments.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing is latent productive capacity that becomes visible when water is delivered from above: the low earth moves, rises, and produces life.

activation_trace.role: The upper direction anchors the vertical relation later occupied by descending water.
Stable growing good supplies the earth's latent fecundity.
Life-maintaining food anchors revival to the focus's provisioning outcome.
Delivery downward supplies the activating input to the earth.
Water conveyed by pouring or irrigation supplies the material agent of activation.
Earth and plants stirring with life supplies the first observable response.
Increase and rising supply the expansion of the earth's stored productive capacity.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the completed provisioning effect.

structural_cues: 41:10 repeats فيها around blessing and provisioning; 41:39 returns to the same earth through عليها and أحياها and supplies a descent-to-revival sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vertical delivery, water, movement, increase, and revived earth; I infer that this sequence discloses how the focus's blessing operates. A live alternative is that 41:39 is only an eschatological sign, not an explanation of 41:10.

changed_reading.before: Blessing is an unspecified extra good added to the earth.
changed_reading.after: Blessing is a durable capacity for growth that measured inputs can activate into actual sustenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured sustenance includes concealed development and timed release: fruit matures inside a sheath and pregnancy carries an unseen load until it is placed forth, all within knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Planned preparation anchors the focus's measure as a process, not only a final quantity.
Sustaining food anchors fruit development to the focus's provisions.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supplies governance of otherwise hidden stages.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the release stage.
Ripe fruit supplies the mature provisioning product.
The plant's enclosing sheath supplies a protected hidden-development stage.
An inwardly carried load or fruit supplies the gestational phase of the mechanism.
Putting down a carried load in birth supplies the endpoint of timed emergence.

structural_cues: 41:47 balances what fruit exits from its sheaths with what a female carries and delivers, enclosing both processes within repeated علم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, carrying, maturation, emergence, and encompassing knowledge; I infer that قدر in the focus includes scheduling those transitions. A live alternative confines 41:47 to divine knowledge without making it a provisioning mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God measures already available food into fixed quantities.
changed_reading.after: The measure also governs when hidden potential matures and crosses into available provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later denies equality between good and evil while explicitly linking sufficiency to sustaining food; this constrains سواء toward exactness, justice, or enoughness rather than indiscriminate sameness.

activation_trace.role: A just and medial position anchors an equitable rather than merely identical reading.
What keeps life going anchors adequacy as the relevant material threshold.
Equality is explicitly negated here, blocking a rule that unlike things must receive one flat valuation.
Good opposed to ugliness supplies one side of the non-equivalent pair.
Badness supplies the contrasting side that must not be flattened into equality.
Sustenance sufficient for need directly supplies an adequacy bridge back to أقوات.

structural_cues: The same سوى root appears in the later formula لا تستوي, and the surah's final question uses يكف immediately before its appeal to comprehensive witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit non-equivalence and a branch defining sufficient sustenance; I infer that focus equality is calibrated adequacy or an exact temporal total. A live alternative keeps سواء solely attached to the four-day duration.

changed_reading.before: Provision is fair only if every requester receives the same amount.
changed_reading.after: Provision is brought to an exact and sufficient measure; justice can answer differing needs without treating every object, act, or claimant as interchangeable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later asking is restless and asymmetrical: people never tire of calling for good, claim mercy as their own, withdraw when favored, and become expansive in prayer when hurt. The focus's السائلين therefore names beneficiaries whose response to provision remains morally open.

activation_trace.role: Requesting anchors the focus's recipient as an active demander rather than a passive inventory category.
Calling by speech supplies the repeated human request for good.
Failure to tire under repetition supplies the requester's open-ended appetite.
Speech as belief or position supplies the possessive claim that received mercy is simply mine.
A good condition and gift supply the very provision after which the recipient turns away.
Distance supplies the beneficiary's withdrawal after receiving favor.
Renewed calling supplies the opposite posture when harm arrives.

structural_cues: The closing human portrait alternates favor, possessive speech, withdrawal, harm, and extended الدعاء, returning repeatedly to the conduct of a demander.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated calling, inexhaustible desire, possessive speech, favor, and withdrawal; I infer that السائلين carries a diagnostic human edge. A live alternative treats those closing passages as a separate moral portrait that does not qualify 41:10's recipients.

changed_reading.before: The askers are a uniformly grateful class for whom provision is prepared.
changed_reading.after: Provision answers human need without certifying the asker: asking may express dependence, entitlement, inquiry, or distress, and the response to provision reveals which.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames its discourse as detailed signs for knowers and closes by showing signs until truth becomes clear and sufficient. The focus's measured four-day clause can therefore be both material ordering and an exact sign-answer for questioners.

activation_trace.role: Questioning anchors an audience seeking intelligible resolution.
A stated quantity and limit anchor the focus as a precise response.
Detail that makes parts and meanings distinct supplies the discourse's explanatory mode.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic outcome of the detailed sign.
Becoming manifest supplies the transition from observed order to recognized truth.
Distant horizons supply the large-scale field in which earth's order is shown as a sign.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency supplies the criterion of an adequate answer.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the confirming force of the sign.

structural_cues: The surah opens with detailed signs for a knowing people, places the numbered focus clause near its creation opening, and closes with signs in horizons and selves becoming clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies detail, knowledge, manifestation, horizon-signs, sufficiency, and witness; I infer that the focus's precision addresses inquiry as well as material need. A live alternative reads للسائلين only as beneficiaries of provisions.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports provision but does not itself answer a question.
changed_reading.after: Its measured temporal and material order is also evidentiary speech: a sufficiently detailed answer offered to those who ask how the world is ordered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates cloud-pulse, fixed-basin, and gradual-consumption branches behind words whose immediate grammar is spatial height, blessing, and food. It remains anchored to فوقها وبارك فيها وأقواتها and gains a visible descent-water-revival mechanism in 41:39; downstream prose should present it as a material systems analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فوقها وبارك فيها وقدر فيها أقواتها

activation_trace.role: Repeated parcels of cloud-water supply a pulse model for inputs arriving from above.
Water fixed in a basin supplies storage between input pulses.
Taking sustenance little by little supplies gradual release or consumption.
Delivered descent supplies the recharge event.
Conveyed water supplies the stored and distributed medium.
Vegetative stirring supplies the observable output of a recharge pulse.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a one-time stock deposited during creation.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be modeled as a calibrated recharge system: intermittent inputs are retained and released into life little by little.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because رواسي in the focus denotes mountains, while the cited رسو branch concerns fixing peace among people. It remains lexically anchored and 41:34 supplies a complete relational mechanism from repulsion to close alliance; downstream prose should mark it as a social echo of physical stabilization, never as the noun's primary referent.

activation_trace.role: Fixing peace between people supplies a latent social meaning of stabilization.
Stable growing good supplies the durable benefit sought by relational repair.
Pushing away harm supplies the intervention that begins restabilization.
A connection between parties supplies the relational terrain being repaired.
Active enmity supplies the unstable initial condition.
Protective affection and alliance supply the transformed stable relation.
Close kinship supplies the final intensity of repaired proximity.

changed_reading.before: Stabilizers belong only to the earth's physical terrain.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social echo, the ayah's stabilizing logic can illuminate acts that anchor a divided human field until enmity becomes durable proximity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the strangest activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ل ل mapping for سائلين. It remains anchored to the exact focus occurrence and coheres with water delivery plus fruit emerging from concealment; downstream prose must retain the ordinary asking sense and describe this only as an affordance-image of provision being gently drawn from channels and enclosures.

activation_trace.role: Gentle drawing-out from within supplies an extractability image for access to provision.
A narrow valley channel where water gathers supplies a spatial conduit for accessible provision.
Life-sustaining food anchors the drawn material to the focus's actual object.
Conveyed water supplies material movement through the imagined channels.
Extraction from concealment supplies the release action.
Ripe fruit supplies the provision that becomes available.
The fruit's sheath supplies the enclosure from which provision is drawn.

changed_reading.before: Provision merely exists for people who verbally request it.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch-image, provision is designed to be accessed: water and fruit move from hidden stores through channels into a form that seekers can draw out.

strongest_changes: The focus became a coordinated, knowledge-governed provisioning system rather than a list of independent creation acts.
Blessing became latent productive capacity activated by descending water and completed through hidden maturation and timed emergence.
سواء للسائلين split into coexisting readings of equitable sufficiency, an exact temporal answer, and a moral diagnostic of asking rather than flat sameness.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah cues repeatedly returned the focus's mechanisms through command, revival, gestation, sufficiency, signs, and human asking, allowing physical, epistemic, and ethical readings to remain distinct without forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic scope of سواء remains live between the four-day total and the provisions or their recipients.
The moral asking passages may qualify السائلين directly or may only echo it compositionally.
Cloud-pulse, social-peace, and س ل ل channel activations are coherent but branch-distant and require explicit exploratory containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A calibrated ecology of stability and growth.** **ر س و B001** gives settling firm, **ب ر ك B004** fixed growing good, **ق د ر B001/B005** measured extent and deliberate arrangement, and **ق و ت B001** life-sustaining provision. Repeated *fiha* binds these functions inside one field. I infer that stability enables sustained growth and measured distribution. Mountains, blessing, measure, and food become one provisioning mechanism rather than a list.
2. **Provision as an even meeting point.** **س و ي B006** supplies middle, fairness, and an even meeting place. Its placement before “for the askers” lets the quantified order retain an access dimension. I infer that equal specification makes provision answerable to inquiry or need. The ayah can therefore read as calibrated sufficiency presented on common ground.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:39 later displays the mechanism dynamically: low earth receives water, stirs, rises, and lives. 41:47 adds fruit emerging from sheaths and pregnancy ending in birth, making the measured provisions here latent processes rather than static stores.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A causal provisioning infrastructure.** Lexically, `ر س و B001` is settling firm, `ب ر ك B004` fixed and growing good, `ق د ر B005` arrangement by estimate, and `ق و ت B001` sustenance that keeps life going. Structurally, fixed masses, blessing, measurement, and provisions form a verb chain; 41:11–12 then show earth and sky accepting and executing differentiated order. I assign firmness the role of stable substrate, blessing the role of productive increase, measure the role of allocation, and provisions the role of life support. The causal arrows from stability to productivity to distribution are my abduction, not explicit syntax. They turn the ayah from a list of created features into an ecological supply mechanism.

2. **Provision on equal notice.** `س و ي B006` supplies fairness and an even meeting place, while `س ء ل B001` supplies asking/requesting. Placed after measured provisions, `سواء للسائلين` makes access rather than mere quantity salient; 41:7’s refusal to give provides the social counterimage. I infer that measured sufficiency is arranged without privileged informational access among seekers. The phrase reads as distributive fairness built into provision.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:11–12 confirmed that the provisioning chain belongs to a responsive, directive-governed system. 41:15 then exposed the social opposite: recipients convert derived provision and strength into a claim of autonomy.

baseline.text: Onun üzerine sabit dağlar yerleştirdi, onu bereketli kıldı ve orada besinlerini dört günde belirledi; soranlar için eşit ölçüde.

findings.text: Dağların sağlamlığı, bereketin üretkenliği, ölçü ve besinler tek bir neden zinciri kurar: kararlılık büyümeyi, büyüme de ölçülü yaşam desteğini mümkün kılar.
Besinlerin eşit ölçüde belirlenmesi, yalnızca miktarı değil, ihtiyacını bildirenler arasında ayrıcalıksız erişimi de öne çıkarır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The world is produced as a surveyed, fitted, stabilized, and maintained construction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation is rendered as workshop practice, structural engineering, and ongoing maintenance rather than as undifferentiated origination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Survey, Sizing, and Fabrication
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A maker measures before cutting, assigns form and condition, levels the result, and completes the work.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Creation begins as measurement, not random accumulation. Making, assigning, straightening, and finishing form one fabrication sequence in which every part reaches a fitted limit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is held in a basin, replenished from cloud-borne pulses, and allotted to produce stable growth and food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed water in a basin `quranic:root_000109:B003/m01`; stable and growing benefit `quranic:root_000109:B004/m01`; food that sustains the body `quranic:root_001268:B001/m01`; recurring cloud-water pulses `quranic:root_001188:B008/m01`; spring rain and pasture `quranic:root_000536:B005/m01`; measured allotment `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Blessing takes the material form of a stable water reserve whose measured releases sustain pasture and food. The reservoir scene gives spatial and temporal mechanics to the provision allotted in the surface passage.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Stored Provision in Managed Cycles
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sustenance depends on contained reserves released in measured and recurring portions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The allotted provisions of the earth open into two concrete systems: a rain-fed reservoir and the replenishing udder of a managed herd.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Kneeling Camel and Replenishing Udder
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A camel kneels at pasture, milk is drawn, and the udder refills between measured rounds.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: kneeling camel fixed in place `quranic:root_000109:B001/m01`; milk drawn from a kneeling she-camel `quranic:root_000109:B007/m01`; milk returning between milkings `quranic:root_001188:B006/m01`; intake in timed small portions `quranic:root_001188:B007/m01`; pasture ready for grazing `quranic:root_000956:B007/m01`; recurring watering turn `quranic:root_000536:B004/m01`; spring pasture `quranic:root_000536:B005/m01`; sustaining feed `quranic:root_001268:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The herd scene organizes nourishment through posture, pasture-readiness, watering turns, and udder replenishment. It reframes measured provision as a living reserve that is repeatedly drawn without losing its regulated cycle.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل والجعالة والجعلية ما يجعل للإنسان على الأمر يفعله (maqayis)؛ الجعل ما جعلت لإنسان أجرا له على عمل يعمله؛ الجعالات ما يتجاعل الناس بينهم (ayn)؛ الجعل ما جعل للانسان من شئ على الشئ يفعله؛ الجعالة؛ الجعيلة مثله (sihah)؛ الجعل في العطية؛ الجعالة بالفتح من الشيء تجعله للإنسان؛ ما جعلته للإنسان أجرا على عمله (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarını topluluk olarak ve bunlardan birini tekil biçimde tanımlar. Geçici çerçeve hem boy hem küçüklük yönünü ve tekil ayrımını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarına ilişkindir; yer adı, böcek ve genel bitki kısalığı anlamlarına uzanmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad kullanımına dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğinden türetilmiş değildir.

concept_map.definition: Kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarının topluluk adı ve bu topluluktaki tek bir ağacın adıdır.

facets.statement: Kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarını topluluk olarak, tekil biçimiyle de bunlardan birini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçları anlamında ve topluluk ile tek ağaç arasındaki biçim ayrımında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hurma ağaçlarının boyca kısa ya da küçük oluşuna göre topluca adlandırıldığı kullanımların bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaç türünü, kısalık veya küçüklüğü ve topluluk anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birden çok kısa veya küçük hurma ağacının topluca anıldığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kısa hurma ağaçlarını topluluk olarak adlandırma yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçları; tekili bu ağaçlardan biri

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Küçüklüğün yanında boyca kısalığı da açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnız küçük hurma ağaçlarını bildirir ve ayrı bir söz ailesine dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Küçük hurma ağaçlarını topluca adlandırmada iki dal doğrudan örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem küçük hem kısa ağaçlara uzanır; komşu dalın verilen sınırı yalnız küçüklüktür, bu nedenle tam ikame her bağlamda güvenli değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarının kendisini topluluk olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle yeni dikilmiş küçük sürgünleri ve bunların tekil ile çoğul biçimlerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hurmanın küçük ve henüz gelişmemiş örnekleriyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal boy veya genel küçüklük ölçütüne dayanır; komşu dal ise bitkinin sürgün ve dikim evresini seçer.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı küçük hurma alanındaki yakın ad ile özellikle genç sürgünü anlatan ad, sınırı açıklamak için yeterlidir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعل للنخل الصغار أو القصار، والواحدة جعلة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه جعلة اسم المكان ولا الجعل الدويبة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل النخل يفوت اليد والواحدة جعلة (maqayis)؛ الجعل واحدها جعلة وهي النخل الصغار (ayn)؛ الجعل النخل القصار الواحدة جعلة (sihah)؛ الجعل قصار النخل (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sıcak tencereyi ateşten veya onu taşıyan taşlardan indirirken kullanılan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezi açıkça tanımlar. Aynı tanıklık, tencereyi bu bezle indirme eylemini de ayrı bir türemiş kullanım olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tencereyi indirmeye yarayan ısı koruyucu bez ve onunla yapılan eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret anlamındaki benzer biçim buna girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad ve ona bağlı eylem biçimlerini kapsar; başka dallardaki benzer sesli adlar tanıma alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sıcak tencereyi ateşten veya dayandığı taşlardan indirirken kullanılan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezdir; bu bezle tencereyi indirme eylemi de aynı dala bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Sıcak tencereyi ocaktan indirirken tutmaya yarayan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezdir.
Tencereyi bu bez aracılığıyla ateşten indirme eylemini de bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bezin tencereyi ateşten indirirken ısıdan koruma işlevinde birleşir ve aynı araçla yapılan indirme eylemini de aktarır.

concept_gloss.text: sıcak tencereyi indirme bezi ve onunla indirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem ısıdan koruyan araç adı hem de tencereyi bu araçla ocaktan indirme eylemi birlikte gösterileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bezin koruyucu araç işlevini ve ona bağlı indirme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıcak tencereyi tutup ocaktan indirmeye yarayan bez nesne olarak anıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aracın tencereyi indirme ve eli ısıdan koruma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı bezle tencereyi indirmeyi bildiren eylem kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tencerenin özel bez kullanılarak ocaktan indirilmesi eylem olarak anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tencereyi koruyucu bez aracılığıyla indirme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bezin bağımsız araç adı olarak kullanılmasını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sıcak tencereyi ateşten indirmeye yarayan koruyucu bez

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tencereyi ocaktan indirirken kullanılan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bir bezdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tencerenin içini karıştırıp kaynamasını yatıştırmak için kullanılan bir çubuktur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki araç da sıcak tencereyi güvenli biçimde yönetmeye yarayan ev gereçleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak araç tencerenin dışından tutulmasını ve ocaktan indirilmesini sağlar; komşu araç tencerenin içine sokularak kaynamayı yatıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eli koruyarak tencereyi ateşten indirmeye yarayan taşınabilir bir bezdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tencereyi ateş üzerinde taşımak için iki taşa eklenen üçüncü sabit destektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de ateş üzerindeki tencerenin kurulması ve kaldırılması senaryosunda yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kaldırma sırasında kullanılan koruyucu aracı, komşu dal ise pişirme sırasında tencereyi taşıyan yapısal desteği adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; tencereyi yönetmeye yarayan çubuk ile onu ateşte taşıyan taş, aracın özgül işlevini en açık biçimde ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعال أو الجعالة، وهي خرقة تنزل بها القدر عن النار أو الأثافي ويتقى بها الحر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعالة بمعنى الأجر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعال الخرقة التي تنزل بها القدر عن الأثافي (maqayis)؛ الجعال والجعالة خرقة تنزل بها القدر عن رأس النار يتقى بها من الحر (ayn)؛ الجعال الخرقة التي تنزل بها القدر عن النار؛ أجعلت القدر (sihah)؛ الجعال الخرقة التي تنزل بها القدور؛ أجعلت القدر إجعالا إذا أنزلتها بالجعال (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, küçük bir yer hayvanını ve onun kara renkli oluşunu bildirir; ayrıca bu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu suyu niteleyen bağlı kullanımı verir. Geçici çerçeve bu iki kapsamı doğru ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hayvanın kendisi yalın çekirdektir; suya ilişkin anlam yalnız bu hayvanların suda çok bulunmasını bildiren özel kuruluşta geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın hayvan adı ile yalnız bu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu suyu niteleyen söz öbeği ayrı facetlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kara renkli küçük bir yer hayvanıdır. Buna bağlı söz öbeği, bu hayvanların içine çokça düştüğü veya içinde çoğaldığı suyu niteler.

facets.statement: Kara renkli küçük bir yer hayvanını adlandırır.
Yalnız suyla kurulan kullanımda, bu hayvanların suyun içinde çokça bulunmasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar küçük yer hayvanı anlamında birleşir; kara renk niteliğini ve hayvanların çok bulunduğu suya özgü kullanımı da topluca destekler.

concept_gloss.text: kara küçük yer hayvanı ve bunlarla dolu su
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın hayvan adı ile yalnız bu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu suyu anlatan bağlı kullanım birlikte gösterileceğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan çekirdeğini ve suya bağlı çokluk kullanımını ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlının kendisi yalın bir ad olarak anıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kara renkli küçük yer hayvanı çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu hayvanların çok bulunduğu suyu anlatan bağlı kullanımı dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun içinde söz konusu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suya bağlı hayvan çokluğu ve doluluk yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvanın bağımsız yalın ad olarak kullanılmasını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kara renkli küçük bir yer hayvanı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kara renkli belirli bir küçük yer hayvanını ve ona bağlı su niteliğini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Küçük yer hayvanlarının pek çok türünü topluca kapsayan genel bir sınıf adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal küçük ve yerde yaşayan hayvanlar alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir hayvan adıdır ve suya özgü türemiş kullanımı vardır; komşu dal ise birçok farklı küçük hayvanı içine alan üst sınıftır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel küçük yer hayvanları sınıfı, odak canlının belirli bir ad oluşunu açıklayan en yararlı karşılaştırmadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعل دابة أو دويبة من هوام الأرض، وجمعها جعلان، وما وصف به الماء إذا كثرت فيه الجعلان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعل بمعنى الأجر أو النخل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل دابة من هوام الأرض (ayn)؛ الجعل دويبة؛ جعل الماء بالكسر أي كثر فيه الجعلان (sihah)؛ الجعل دابة سوداء من دواب الأرض تجمع جعلانا؛ ماء مجعل وجعل إذا تهافتت فيه الجعلان (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dişi köpeğin ve diğer yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşmek üzere erkeği istemesini açıkça bildirir. Hem dişi köpekle kurulan söz öbeği hem de çekimli biçimler aynı üreme isteği durumuna bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dişi köpek ve benzeri yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşme isteğiyle sınırlıdır; erkeğin isteğini veya çiftleşmenin gerçekleşmesini bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dişi köpekle kurulan söz öbeği ile dişinin isteğini bildiren çekimli biçimler ayrı tutulur; kapsam genel bir yalın kök anlamına çevrilmez.

concept_map.definition: Dişi köpeğin veya benzeri yırtıcı bir dişinin çiftleşmek için erkeği istemesidir; hem belirli bir söz öbeği hem de çekimli biçimler bu durumu anlatır.

facets.statement: Dişi köpeği, çiftleşmek için erkeği isteyen durumda niteleyen söz öbeğidir.
Dişi köpek ve diğer yırtıcı dişilerin erkeği istemesi durumunu çekimli biçimlerle bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dişi köpeğin ve diğer yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşme isteğinde birleşir ve söz öbeği ile çekimli biçimleri aynı duruma bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dişi köpek veya benzeri yırtıcı dişinin çiftleşme isteğini bildiren hem niteleme hem eylem biçimlerini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Dişi katılımcıyı, erkeğe yönelen isteği ve çiftleşme amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dişi köpek veya benzeri bir yırtıcı dişinin erkeği istediği durum niteleme olarak verildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dişi hayvanın çiftleşmeye yönelik erkek isteğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dişi köpek ve benzeri yırtıcı dişiler için belirli niteleme ve eylem biçimlerine dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koyun, sığır ve keçi gibi daha geniş evcil hayvan sınıflarına da uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dişi köpek ve yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşme isteğinde iki dal doğrudan örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın tür sınırı köpek ve benzeri yırtıcılardır; komşu dal aynı durumu daha geniş bir hayvan listesinde adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dişi köpek ve diğer yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşme isteğine özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aynı isteği yalnız dişi deve için adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal dişi hayvanın çiftleşmek üzere erkeği istemesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek durum aynıdır, ancak tür kapsamları ayrıdır: odak dal köpek ve yırtıcı dişilere, komşu dal dişi deveye bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; daha geniş hayvan kapsamlı yakın ad ile dişi deveye özgü ad, tür sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مجعل وأجعلت واستجعلت للكلبة والسباع إذا أرادت السفاد أو اشتهت الفحل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعل الدويبة ولا الفعل العام جعل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: كلبة مجعل إذا أرادت السفاد (maqayis)؛ أجعلت الكبة واستجعلت فهي مجعل إذا أرادت السفاد وكذلك سائر السباع (sihah)؛ أجعلت الكلبة والسباع كلها إذا اشتهت الفحل؛ استجعلت أيضا بمعناه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söz konusu biçimi doğrudan deve kuşunun yavrusu olarak açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu hayvan türü ve yaşam evresi ayrımını eksiksiz yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırır; genel yavru, başka kuş yavrusu veya deve yavrusu anlamına genişlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad kullanımına dayanır ve herhangi bir özel söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırır.

facets.statement: Türü deve kuşu olan genç yavruyu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adın deve kuşunun yavrusunu bildirdiği konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız deve kuşunun genç yavrusu adlandırıldığında eksiksiz ve doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan türünü ve yavruluk evresini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlı bir cümlede deve kuşunun yavrusundan söz edilirken doğal sözcük sırasını sağlar.

error_profile.preserves: Deve kuşu türünü ve yavruluk durumunu eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız deve kuşu yavrusunu adlandıran tek anlamlı kullanım burada esastır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deve kuşu yavrusunun yanında küçük develeri ve hizmetçileri de kapsayan daha geniş bir anlam kümesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: deve kuşu yavruları ve başka topluluklar
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Deve kuşunun yavrusunu adlandırma alanında iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bütünüyle deve kuşu yavrusuna bağlıdır; komşu dal aynı karşılığın yanında tür ve insan bakımından başka anlamlara da uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yavruluğu özellikle deve kuşu türüne bağlayan özel bir addır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan, evcil hayvan ve yabanıl hayvan yavrularını genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğumdan sonraki genç ve küçük yaşam evresini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tür bakımından özeldir; komşu dal pek çok canlı türünün yavrusunu içine alan genel sınıf adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; çok anlamlı yakın ad ile genel yavru adı, tür ve kapsam sınırlarını en yararlı biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعول بمعنى الرأل، ولد النعام.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعل الدويبة ولا الجعل النخل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعول ولد النعام (maqayis)؛ الجعول الرأل ولد النعام (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, sözün bir yer adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir ve bundan başka bir yer kimliği veya genel anlam vermez. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırlı tanıklığı doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Adın gösterdiği belirli yer açıklanmadığı için tanım bir yer kimliği uydurmaz ve sözü genel yer anlamına dönüştürmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız belirli ad biçimine bağlıdır; genel veya yalın bir yer anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Kaynağın yalnızca bir yer adı olduğunu bildirdiği, gösterdiği yer açıklanmayan özel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kimliği belirtilmeyen bir yer için kullanılan özel addır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu kullanım tek bir tanıklıkla sınırlıdır ve yerin kimliğine ilişkin ek bir ortak açıklama bulunmaz.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık sözü bir yer adı olarak sınıflandırır, fakat hangi yeri gösterdiğini açıklamaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynağın belirli yer kimliğini açıklamadan yalnızca yer adı diye sınıflandırdığı bu özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer adı olma bilgisini ve yer kimliğinin belirtilmemiş oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün genel yer anlamı taşımadığı, yalnız özel ad olarak kullanıldığı açıklanırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözü kimliği belirtilmemiş özel bir yer adı olarak korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; adayların her biri başka ve belirli bir yer adını veya genel yer alanını gösterir, ancak odak adın hangi yerle özdeş olduğunu kanıtlamaz; bu yüzden yayımlanabilir bir karşıtlık seçilmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعلة حين يصرح المصدر بأنها اسم مكان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعلة الواحدة من النخل الصغار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجَعْلة اسم مكان (maqayis)

source_note.MQ: Tek tanıklık sözü bir yer adı olarak sınıflandırır, fakat hangi yeri gösterdiğini açıklamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını tek bir betimleyici anlam olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu üç kurucu niteliği doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç nitelik birlikte kurucudur; yalnız kısa, yalnız şişman veya yalnız inatçı olan biri bu dalın tam kapsamına girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın betimleyici kullanıma dayanır ve özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını anlatan nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Kısa, şişman ve tartışmada inatla direnen kişiyi üç niteliği birlikte taşıyarak betimler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu birleşik kişi betimlemesi tek bir tanıklığa dayanır; kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte verilir.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık üç niteliği ayırmadan kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi betimlemesinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişide beden kısalığı, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte anlatıldığında tam karşılık verir.

error_profile.preserves: Kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçılığın birlikte bulunması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üç niteliği birlikte taşıyan bir kişiyi doğal cümle içinde nitelemek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi belirleyen üç kurucu niteliğin tümünü birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şişmanlık ile tartışmada inatla direnme niteliklerini kısalıkla birlikte gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalın, güçlü ve toplu beden yapısını bildirir, fakat inatçılığı gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kısa ve toplu beden yapısına sahip kişiyi betimlemede iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedensel kısalık ve şişmanlığa davranışsal inatçılığı ekler; komşu dal ise bedensel kalınlık ve gücü öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısalık ve inatçı çekişkenliği şişmanlıkla birlikte zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya hayvanda bedenin dolgunlaşıp yağlanmasını anlatır, boy ve huy koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Şişmanlık ve beden dolgunluğu anlam alanında iki dal buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üçlü bir kişi niteliğidir; komşu dal yalnız bedensel dolgunluğu seçer ve farklı canlı türlerine de uygulanabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; kısa ve toplu kişi betimi ile genel beden dolgunluğu, üç niteliğin birlikte bulunması koşulunu en açık biçimde ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعل بمعنى اجتماع القصر والسمن واللجاج في وصف الشخص.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه قصر النخل ولا الدويبة المسماة جعلا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل القصر مع السمن واللجاج (tahdhib)

source_note.TA: Tek tanıklık üç niteliği ayırmadan kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi betimlemesinde birleştirir.

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir şeyi var etme, bir duruma sokma, adlandırma ve eyleme başlama gibi eylem anlamlarından; iş karşılığı, küçük hurma ağacı, tencere bezi, küçük yer hayvanı, dişinin eş istemesi, deve kuşu yavrusu, yer adı ve birleşik kişi betimi gibi birbirinden uzak ad alanlarına yayılır. Bu dallar tek bir çağdaş çekirdeğe indirgenemeyen belirgin bir çok anlamlılık oluşturur.
